mechanism_narrative: Sustained decline in WORKPLACES mobility over the past four weeks signals persistent remote work adoption. This reduces commuter-adjacent retail visits, driving RETAIL_REC further negative over the next four weeks as the baseline of office-dependent shopping erodes.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES declined from -21.7% to -27.1% over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases above the prior four-week mean during the forecast period despite WORKPLACES remaining below -25%.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility collapsed from 12.4% to 1.9% over two weeks, indicating outdoor recreation substitution has exhausted. Consumers redirect discretionary time to indoor retail-and-recreation venues, reversing the recent -24.4% decline over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls below 3% from prior week above 4%
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below -20% in the next two weeks after PARKS collapse, or PARKS rebounds above 8% without RETAIL_REC rising.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility has contracted consistently to -26.3%, indicating suppressed commuting and discretionary travel. When TRANSIT falls below -25%, the interaction of low workplace attendance and low transit use creates a regime where retail-and-recreation cannot recover, keeping RETAIL_REC negative.
evidence_refs: fact:Both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES are at -26.3% and -27.1% respectively
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above -15% within four weeks while both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain below -25%.

mechanism_narrative: Mid-July baseline represents peak summer seasonality. GROCERY_PHARM has turned negative (-2.7%), signaling demand saturation across essential categories. This compression of essential mobility frees discretionary budget for retail-and-recreation, reversing the four-week decline trend over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM declined from +2.7% to -2.7% over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase above the prior four-week mean despite GROCERY_PHARM remaining negative for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility has stabilized near +1.3%, indicating no new lockdown or shelter-in-place orders are imminent. The absence of rising residential confinement signals policy stability, allowing retail-and-recreation to recover from its -24.4% trough as restrictions remain constant over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stable at +1.3% in most recent week
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL rises above 5% or RETAIL_REC declines further despite RESIDENTIAL stability.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction of collapsing PARKS (1.9%) and stable RESIDENTIAL (+1.3%) indicates consumers are neither outdoors nor confined—they are indoors but mobile. This creates pent-up demand for indoor retail-and-recreation venues, reversing the -24.4% decline within one week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS below 3% AND RESIDENTIAL between 0% and 3%
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS at 1.9% and RESIDENTIAL at 1.3% in t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within one week of PARKS falling below 3% while RESIDENTIAL remains stable.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT decline has accelerated from -23.9% to -26.3% over four weeks, indicating a structural shift away from public mobility. This persistent transit suppression will continue to depress retail-and-recreation mobility over the next four weeks, as retail venues dependent on transit access lose foot traffic.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT declines more than 2 percentage points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases above -15% over the next four weeks while TRANSIT remains below -24%.

mechanism_narrative: The three-way interaction of low WORKPLACES (-27.1%), low TRANSIT (-26.3%), and low PARKS (1.9%) creates a regime where consumers lack commute-based retail access, public transit mobility, and outdoor alternatives. This forces a reallocation to accessible indoor retail-and-recreation, reversing the decline over two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES below -25% AND TRANSIT below -25% AND PARKS below 5%
evidence_refs: fact:All three mobility channels suppressed simultaneously in t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase above -20% within two weeks when all three proxies remain in the suppressed regime.
